structured_output.title: Environment already sets global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole value
structured_output.content: The environment's values set the key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, which the v1.18.0 release notes describe as a new helm value that disables HTTP-01 ACME challenges and drops cert-manager's permission to create pods. Inspect the value actually set (the summary shows only key paths, not values) and whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer relies on HTTP-01 solvers. If the value is true, HTTP-01 challenges would be disabled after the upgrade. The environment summary shows the key set while the installed version is v1.17.0, so check how that key behaves in each version before upgrading.
